operationalConstraints.runtimeUserUploads: Runtime and user-supplied uploads must not be passed to Metro.
operationalConstraints.publicForkAssets: Malicious public-fork assets may reach pull-request build inputs and cause CI availability DoS.
operationalConstraints.prCiCredentials: PR CI has no secrets or static provider credentials.
operationalConstraints.easSigningDeployment: EAS preview, signing, and deployment credentials are not run in PR CI.

exceptions.reason: Metro's image-size parser is reachable only in build-time tooling; runtime and user-supplied uploads do not reach Metro. A malicious public-fork asset may still cause CI availability DoS.
exceptions.removeWhen: Remove when image-size publishes a patched release or an Expo SDK update replaces the affected Metro dependency.
exceptions.operationalConstraint: Runtime and user-supplied uploads do not reach Metro; public-fork assets are processed only by the read-only, 20-minute pull_request verify job with no secrets or static credentials, and EAS/sign/deploy credentials are not run in PR CI.
